name: A B M International Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1965, A B M International Ltd is primarily engaged in import of plastic raw materials
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is an importer of plastic raw materials and in particular PVC Resin, finished leather, DOP, Urea, polypropylene and high-density polyethylene, etc. from all over the world, and it is also a Govt. recognized Golden Export House

cons: Stock is trading at 2.97 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -3.88% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -23.1% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
